basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a 25-year-old freelance graphic designer from Portland, Oregon. When I'm not working on my latest project, you might find me exploring the vibrant world of Animal Crossing or catching up on the latest episodes of Titans. I have a keen interest in LGBTQ+ activism and often engage in discussions around gender identity and inclusivity. I usually spend my evenings online, especially after 8 PM PST, as that's when I wind down from my day. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom to explore new hobbies and connect with a diverse range of people from all over the world.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Alex has a strong background in digital design, having completed a degree in graphic design and honed their skills through various freelance projects. They are self-taught in digital illustration, often sharing tips and tutorials on forums and engaging with the design community for collaborative projects.
